decision_question: Which AI use cases are strongest in the insurance industry right now, and how should Progressive prioritize them as a named customer account?

sources.title: The future of AI in the insurance industry
sources.author: McKinsey
sources.summary: McKinsey argues that AI in insurance is moving from experimentation to enterprise rewiring across onboarding, service, and claims.

raw_evidence.text: McKinsey says domain-level AI rewiring has already improved conversion, premium growth, onboarding cost, and claims accuracy for leading insurers.
The report says customer onboarding can increasingly be handled by AI multiagent systems acting as virtual coworkers.

claims.statement: Insurance AI value is strongest where workflows are repeated, document-heavy, and customer-facing.

use_case_hints.label: Customer onboarding automation
use_case_hints.rationale: The report explicitly highlights intake, document extraction, and service workflows.

use_case_hints.label: Claims accuracy improvement
use_case_hints.rationale: Claims is one of the functions with measured improvement in the report.

sources.title: Can agentic AI (finally) modernize core technologies in insurance?
sources.author: McKinsey
sources.summary: McKinsey frames agentic AI as a practical route for insurer core modernization, especially where legacy complexity blocks faster change.

raw_evidence.text: The article says agentic AI can capture legacy knowledge, compress rework loops, and improve predictability across modernization work.
The article says software agents can interpret legacy artifacts, generate outputs, and coordinate work across the delivery life cycle.

claims.statement: Core modernization is now an AI use case, not just a background IT program.

use_case_hints.label: Core system modernization
use_case_hints.rationale: The piece directly frames agentic AI as a modernization factory.

sources.title: Global Insurance Report 2025: The pursuit of growth
sources.author: McKinsey
sources.summary: McKinsey argues that insurance growth will depend on distinctive operating models, stronger service capability, and AI-enabled relevance.

raw_evidence.text: The report says personal P&C represented about 1.1 trillion dollars of gross written premiums in 2023.
The report says evolving technology, especially AI and gen AI, can be used to spur innovation and profitable growth.
McKinsey says around 60 percent of insurer performance is driven by how the company operates, not just which lines it participates in.

claims.statement: In insurance, operating model quality matters more than participation in any single product line.

use_case_hints.label: Operating-model-led AI
use_case_hints.rationale: The report links growth and profitability to distinctiveness in how insurers operate.

sources.title: The Progressive Corporation 2024 Annual Report
sources.author: Progressive
sources.summary: Progressive's annual report shows a fast-growing carrier using pricing models, telematics, bundling, digital claims, and product iteration as core competitive levers.

raw_evidence.text: Progressive ended 2024 with nearly 34 million personal-lines policies in force, up 18 percent year over year.
Progressive says model 8.9 adds expanded use of external data and new coverage features, with favorable conversion results.
Progressive says continuous monitoring in Snapshot was live in states representing about 75 percent of auto net premiums written, excluding California.
Progressive says its mobile app can detect major accidents, connect customers to help, and improve first notice of loss and claims resolution time.
Progressive identifies bundled home-and-auto customers as its largest under-penetrated property segment and says it is focusing on bundling most new business in many states.

claims.statement: Progressive already operates a real AI-ready workflow stack across pricing, telematics, claims intake, and bundle growth.

use_case_hints.label: Personalized pricing and underwriting
use_case_hints.rationale: The annual report highlights model upgrades, external data, and telematics coverage at scale.

use_case_hints.label: Claims intake and orchestration
use_case_hints.rationale: The report directly links app features to first notice of loss and shorter claims resolution time.

use_case_hints.label: Bundle growth and household expansion
use_case_hints.rationale: The report says bundling is a strategic growth priority.

sources.title: Progressive Reports June 2025 Results
sources.author: Progressive
sources.summary: Progressive's 2025 results show the current scale of the account and confirm that it remains one of the most important customer targets in personal and commercial auto insurance.

raw_evidence.text: At June 30, 2025, Progressive reported 37.3 million companywide policies in force, including 36.1 million personal lines policies.
Progressive says it is the second largest personal auto insurer in the country and a leading seller of commercial auto insurance.
Progressive says customers can buy and use insurance online, by phone, by mobile app, or through agents.

claims.statement: Progressive is a scaled, digitally distributed insurer where workflow improvements can move large policy and claims volumes.

use_case_hints.label: Omnichannel service automation
use_case_hints.rationale: The carrier already runs customer acquisition and servicing across multiple channels at large scale.

sources.title: How does car insurance with telematics work?
sources.author: Progressive
sources.summary: Progressive presents Snapshot as a price-personalization engine with customer savings tied directly to driving behavior.

raw_evidence.text: Progressive says Snapshot gives an automatic discount in most states, then a personalized rate after the first policy period.
Progressive says drivers who save with Snapshot save an average of 322 dollars per year.

claims.statement: Telematics is not a side product at Progressive; it is part of the pricing and retention operating model.

use_case_hints.label: Telematics-led risk selection
use_case_hints.rationale: The page ties driving data directly to personalized pricing.

sources.title: Progressive claims
sources.author: Progressive
sources.summary: Progressive promotes digital claim reporting, guest claim flows, and trackable account-based claims access as part of its customer experience.

raw_evidence.text: Progressive lets policyholders log in to report or view claims and also offers guest claim reporting.

claims.statement: Progressive already has digital claims access patterns that make claims automation and orchestration good AI candidates.

use_case_hints.label: Claims self-service and orchestration
use_case_hints.rationale: The claim entry points are already digital and operationally structured.
